lines.speaker: anne
lines.text: Huh? Why are the lights off?

lines.speaker: anne
lines.text: Teacher! Looks like we're the first ones back!
Why don't you go ahead and turn on the lights?

lines.speaker: anne
lines.text: Sure thing!
*Pop!* *Pop pop!*

lines.speaker: unknown
lines.text: Merry Christmas!
As soon as the lights flicker on, the sound of party poppers fills the air.
Rapi is holding a cake made entirely of Light Croquettes stacked together.
Neon is firing off as many party poppers as she can.
Anis shows up with as many soda bottles as her hands can carry.

lines.speaker: anne
lines.text: What's all this...?

lines.speaker: anis
lines.text: Don't just stand there, Anne. Hurry up and blow out those candles!

lines.speaker: anne
lines.text: Oh... Uh... Okay!
Anne blows out the candles.

lines.speaker: anne
lines.text: *Blow*

lines.speaker: anis
lines.text: Hey Anne, get a load out of this cake! This whole thing is made out of Light Croquettes!

lines.speaker: anne
lines.text: Really?! All of it?
Rapi nods her head.

lines.speaker: rapi
lines.text: Every last bit.

lines.speaker: neon
lines.text: What do you think? Pretty great, right?

lines.speaker: anne
lines.text: Yes! It's really cool!

lines.speaker: anis
lines.text: Looks like I made the right choice. I wanted to get you something more special than the usual Christmas cake.

lines.speaker: anne
lines.text: So you wanted to give me something special...

lines.speaker: neon
lines.text: Before we eat, how about we open the presents first?

lines.speaker: neon
lines.text: Ta-da! Here's my gift!
Neon takes out a calico cat plushie holding a toy pistol.

lines.speaker: anne
lines.text: Eh? Is this the one from the claw machine?

lines.speaker: neon
lines.text: So you remember! Yep, that's the one!

lines.speaker: neon
lines.text: You have no idea how much I struggled to get this thing...

lines.speaker: anis
lines.text: Huh? Why's it holding a gun? Did they come out with a new version or something?

lines.speaker: neon
lines.text: Since it's a Christmas gift, how could I give something so ordinary?

lines.speaker: anis
lines.text: Wait... don't tell me you stuck a gun on it just to make sure everyone knows it was from you?

lines.speaker: neon
lines.text: Of course! Guns mean firepower! And when you think of firepower, you'll think me!

lines.speaker: anis
lines.text: Hold up... this gun's not real, right?

lines.speaker: neon
lines.text: Of course it is.

lines.speaker: anis
lines.text: Are you insane?!
Anne gingerly picks up the plushie.

lines.speaker: anne
lines.text: A kitty with a gun?! That's so cool!

lines.speaker: anne
lines.text: Thank you, Neon!

lines.speaker: neon
lines.text: You actually like it? I knew you'd get me!

lines.speaker: anis
lines.text: *Sigh* As long as Anne likes it...

lines.speaker: anis
lines.text: Anyway, mine's nothing crazy.
Anis takes out a pink bookmark with croquettes painted on it.

lines.speaker: anne
lines.text: Is this...

lines.speaker: anis
lines.text: Well, I wanted to get you something special, so I checked out a bunch of places.

lines.speaker: anis
lines.text: I heard that you like croquettes and bookmarks, so here you go.

lines.speaker: anis
lines.text: Plus, it's a limited edition, I think...

lines.speaker: anis
lines.text: Hmm... is it not to your liking?

lines.speaker: anne
lines.text: No! It's beautiful. I really love it!

lines.speaker: anne
lines.text: I just... I didn't expect there to be so many special gifts. They make me so happy...

lines.speaker: rapi
lines.text: Mine isn't anything spectacular, either.
Rapi produces an album with a blue butterfly pattern on it.

lines.speaker: anne
lines.text: Huh? What's this? Is it a notebook?

lines.speaker: rapi
lines.text: It's a photo album.
Rapi opens the album to reveal the pages inside.

lines.speaker: rapi
lines.text: Think of it as a notebook, but for photos.

lines.speaker: rapi
lines.text: I noticed you and Rupee have been snapping pics all over the place lately, so I figured you might find this useful.

lines.speaker: anne
lines.text: A notebook that stores photos!

lines.speaker: anne
lines.text: That's really amazing!

lines.speaker: rapi
lines.text: I'm glad you like it.

lines.speaker: anne
lines.text: I've got something for you too!

lines.speaker: anis
lines.text: Huh? No way...

lines.speaker: anne
lines.text: Rapi.

lines.speaker: anne
lines.text: Neon.

lines.speaker: anne
lines.text: Anis.

lines.speaker: anne
lines.text: Merry Christmas!
Anne holds out a glass bottles with star candies inside towards the three.

lines.speaker: rapi
lines.text: Are those...

lines.speaker: anis
lines.text: Star candies?
A few hours ago.
Anne and I enter the candy store.

lines.speaker: anne
lines.text: You're telling me they have stars in the candy shop?
Here.
I lead Anne straight to the aisle.

lines.speaker: anne
lines.text: What? Star candies?
Anne picks up the glass bottle with star candies in it.

lines.speaker: anne
lines.text: Wow... it's so beautiful! Everything's sparkling!

lines.speaker: anne
lines.text: There are so many stars here, Teacher!
You like them?

lines.speaker: anne
lines.text: Yes, I sure do!

lines.speaker: anne
lines.text: Okay! I've decided—I'll go with this one, Teacher!

lines.speaker: anne
lines.text: Rapi, Neon, Anis,

lines.speaker: anne
lines.text: and Teacher.

lines.speaker: anne
lines.text: My memory's still a bit hazy...

lines.speaker: anne
lines.text: but I do remember eating Light Croquettes together with you all for a long time and trying to catch the kitty plushie in the claw machine.

lines.speaker: anne
lines.text: You even helped me pick out bookmarks!

lines.speaker: anne
lines.text: And now, you've thrown a whole Christmas party just for me... I'm just... really, really thankful!
Anne holds out a jar of star candies to me.

lines.speaker: anis
lines.text: I know I asked you to buy some gifts, but I didn't think you'd actually go and buy them...

lines.speaker: anne
lines.text: Oh, if you don't like them...

lines.speaker: anis
lines.text: No, it's not that! It's not that I don't like them! It's just... I'm really moved, you know?

lines.speaker: anis
lines.text: Thank you. I'll cherish them always.

lines.speaker: neon
lines.text: It was so nice of you, Anne!

lines.speaker: rapi
lines.text: Thank you, Anne.
I didn't realize you got me one too...

lines.speaker: anne
lines.text: Why not? You're someone I'm grateful to... No, you're the most special person to me!
... Thank you, Anne.

lines.speaker: anne
lines.text: No, thank you, Teacher!

lines.speaker: unknown
lines.text: My my, isn't this a wonderful display of affection?
*Swoosh*

lines.speaker: emma_c
lines.text: A Christmas miracle wouldn't be complete without Santa!

lines.speaker: anne
lines.text: Santa!

lines.speaker: exia_c
lines.text: Don't forget about your good friend Rudolph, who's back thanks to the wonders of overtime pay!

lines.speaker: anne
lines.text: Rudolph!

lines.speaker: emma_c
lines.text: I've checked my list, Anne. And guess what? You've been such a good girl this year!
Santa Emma hands Anne a pack of handmade cookies.

lines.speaker: anis
lines.text: Not those again...

lines.speaker: anne
lines.text: Thanks, Santa!

lines.speaker: neon
lines.text: Anne, don't take that!

lines.speaker: emma_c
lines.text: Aw, you don't have to look so down, everyone. I've made plenty of cookies for all of you.

lines.speaker: exia_c
lines.text: I tossed some of my own super delicious cookies into the mix, so if you manage to pick one, you might not die... maybe.

lines.speaker: anis
lines.text: The real Christmas miracle would be surviving your gift.

lines.speaker: exia_c
lines.text: For the good little Anne, here are some truly delicious Rudolph cookies.

lines.speaker: anne
lines.text: They're lovely! Thank you, Rudolph!

lines.speaker: unknown
lines.text: But wait! There's more!
*Crash*

lines.speaker: laplace
lines.text: The hero has arrived!

lines.speaker: anis
lines.text: Why the window when there's a perfectly good door right there... ugh, never mind.

lines.speaker: laplace
lines.text: Word has it that there's one heck of a Yuletide bash going on in these parts.

lines.speaker: laplace
lines.text: A hero like me could never miss such a dazzling event!

lines.speaker: anne
lines.text: Laplace!

lines.speaker: laplace
lines.text: It's so great to see you again!

lines.speaker: laplace
lines.text: In that spirit, here's a gift from the hero!

lines.speaker: anne
lines.text: Oh?
Laplace opens a yellow sack and scatters what's inside onto the ground.
Are those...
A cluster of golden stars falls in front of Anne.

lines.speaker: laplace
lines.text: These are all the stars I gathered for you, kiddo!

lines.speaker: laplace
lines.text: How's that for some Christmas cheer?
Anne picks up a star from the ground.

lines.speaker: anne
lines.text: I... I'm speechless! They're just so beautiful!

lines.speaker: laplace
lines.text: Hahaha! Merry Christmas!

lines.speaker: anis
lines.text: Have you gone mental? What if we step on them? Put them back in the sack!
Together with Laplace, we stuff the stars back into the sack and begin to enjoy the Christmas party in earnest.

lines.speaker: anne
lines.text: ... Teacher.
Anne tugs at my sleeve.
What's wrong?

lines.speaker: anne
lines.text: It's just... I feel a little strange.

lines.speaker: anne
lines.text: Today has been so amazing that... I kind of wish tomorrow would never come.

lines.speaker: anne
lines.text: All of this joy, this happiness...

lines.speaker: anne
lines.text: What if I forget it all?
With time, memories fade for everyone.

lines.speaker: anne
lines.text: Even you, Teacher?
Yes, even me.

lines.speaker: anne
lines.text: So... what would you do in situations like this, Teacher?
Try to enjoy the moment, so you don't regret it later.
Try to hold onto this happiness and remember it.

lines.speaker: anne
lines.text: Enjoy the moment...

lines.speaker: anne
lines.text: Try my best to remember...
I pat Anne on the head.
Now, let's go make some more happy memories.

lines.speaker: anne
lines.text: Okay, I will.

lines.speaker: neon
lines.text: Master! Anne!

lines.speaker: neon
lines.text: Look here!
Neon is standing a few paces away with a camera.

lines.speaker: neon
lines.text: All right, say cheese!

lines.speaker: neon
lines.text: One, two, three!
*Click*
